lead: Hardeep Singh Puri is an Indian diplomat, born on 15 February 1952 in Amritsar.
As of 2026, he is 74 years old, and his birth date places him under the Aquarius sign.
He has held the office of member of Rajya Sabha and Minister of Petroleum and Natural Gas.
The sections that follow break down Hardeep Singh Puri's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Hardeep Singh Puri — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Hardeep Singh Puri was born on 15 February 1952 in Amritsar, and holds Indian nationality.
He studied at Hindu College, University of Delhi.
He is recorded as speaking English.

sections.heading: Hardeep Singh Puri — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists diplomat, politician and minister as his occupations, including work with United Nations.

He has held the following offices: member of Rajya Sabha, Minister of Petroleum and Natural Gas (2021–present), Minister of Urban Development (2017–present), President of the United Nations Security Council (2011–2011) and President of the United Nations Security Council (2012–2012). He is affiliated with Bharatiya Janata Party.
He has taken part in India Economic Conclave 2022.

sections.heading: Hardeep Singh Puri — Family, Marriage and Personal Life
paras: He is married to Lakshmi Puri.
